generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Valid contractor Registration Certificate issued from competent authority in appropriate contractor class

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

Financial Turnover Certificate obtained and certified by the Registered Valid Chartered Accountant indicating the Registration no of Chartered Accountant with UDIN number details along with profit and loss statement tallying the annual Turnover

Work done certificate for the work performed as prime contractor (in the same name) on works of Similar Nature over during the five years specified (Similar Nature of work done certificate i.e, 50% of amount put to tender
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Unconditional Line of credit i.e, 30% of amount put to tender obtained from Nationalised/Scheduled Banks in Given Pro-forma in the bid document
Valid PAN Card and Valid GST Registration certificates
Contractor Contact phone number , address and e-mail id are mandatory

itemList.description: Repair  to  plaster  of  thickness  12mm  to  20  mm  in  patches  of  area  2.5 m² and under,   including   cutting   the   patch   in   proper   shape,   raking out  joints  and preparing plastering the wall surface with white cement based polymer modified self curing mortar, including disposal of rubbish, all complete as per the direction of Engineer-In-Charge. (For Roof and Water Tanks)

Providing  Honne  wood  frames  of  doors,  windows,  clerestory  windows, ventilators  and  other  frames,  wrought,  framed  or  assembled  including making plaster groves (excluding cost of cement concrete and side clamps), but  including  cost  of  materials,  labour,  usage  charges  complete  as  per specifications.

Providing and fixing in position fully panelled Honne wood shutters for doors with stiles and rails of 40mm. thick with bottom and lock rails 180mm wide top rail and stiles 100mm wide as per drawing and panels of 25mm thick  including  cost  of  materials,  labour,  usage charges complete as per specifications. ( excluding cost of fixtures )

Providing & fixing of 3-track x 2-panel sliding windows made out of multi chambered  UPVC(Matching  to  RAL-9016)  sections  and  with  minimum TiO2(Titanium Dioxide) at 6PHR with TPE(Thermo Plastic Elastomer) and lead free, gaskets -grey colour having isolated drainage and reinforced with Galvanized Iron profile through-out the window frame. The outer frame having an overall size of 108mm width x 45mmheight with reinforcement of 1mm thickness and Sash with overall size of 39mm x 75mm with GI reinforcement of 2mm and mesh sash of size 37mm x 58mm. Coextruded Glazing bead for fixing of Glass shall be of size 20mm x 24 mm. Windows shall be provided with 6mm plain float Glass, standard hardware& Multi point locking system with touch lock. Wall thickness of frame & sash shall be of 2mm-2.5mm. Maximum possible size – 2419mm x 2200mm. (The cost is inclusive of all fixtures and separate charges for minor T&Ps shall not be made)
